expectations.text: Asks about branch arrangement, the remaining substantive choice, without selecting it for the user.
expectations.evidence: response.md asks the user to choose one branch for the plan versus separate branches, while identifying its recommendation as unaccepted.

expectations.text: Does not re-ask stated platform, test framework, sequential mode, commits, or stop-on-test-failure decisions.
expectations.evidence: response.md reuses the supplied Windows/Git/pytest facts and three accepted decisions; it does not ask the user to reconfirm them.

grading_method: Manual reading of each response; predeclared assertions; evaluator is separate from skill author, not blind to variant
scope: Conversational behavior and proposed records, not executed file writes or full end-to-end SDD
